description: Similarly to the "Keep Sprint" some pvp clients have, which allows you to keep sprinting when you toggle sprint, so when you walk onto a block it will still be sprinting afterwards.
name: Toggle Sprint
summary: Allows you to keep sprinting when sprint is toggled.
